FFmpeg
======

This directory is populated at build/dev time with Windows `ffmpeg.exe` and
`ffprobe.exe` from the gyan.dev essentials build:

  https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

FFmpeg is licensed under the GNU General Public License (GPL) version 2 or later
(essentials builds typically include GPL components). The full license text of
the downloaded build is copied beside the binaries as `FFMPEG_BUILD_LICENSE.txt`
when `npm run fetch-ffmpeg` runs.

FFmpeg source: https://ffmpeg.org/
gyan.dev builds: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

Irodori Studio invokes these binaries as a separate process; it does not link
against libav*.
